text:
Felix: Hey folks — moving cross-country Sunday, need someone to take my small L-shaped desk (Ikea Bekant corner, black-brown). Solid condition but heavy. Free if you can pick up from the SF office by Saturday afternoon. Pics: https://imgur.com/deskcorner

Zara: Interested! Rough dimensions? Trying to figure out if it fits in my hatchback.

Felix: It's about `140cm x 140cm` with a 60cm depth on the wedge. Disassembles into top + two legs. I can strip it and label the screws.

Mika: If Zara can't make it, I'm also keen. I have a truck rental Saturday morning.

AskFacilitiesBot: Note: building freight elevator reservation required for bulky items. Book via facilities portal at least 24h in advance.

Zara: I can do Saturday 11am pickup. Will book freight elevator now. DMing you for phone #, Felix.

Omar: Heads up — please bring moving blankets if you're using the elevator. We had a scratched floor last month.

Felix: Thanks Omar. I'll leave the underside label "For Zara" on the desk once I disassemble. If anything changes I'll update here.

Mika: Sounds good. If Zara falls through, let me know and I can pick it up midday Saturday.

Zara: Claimed. Thanks y'all! Felix, DM received and elevator reserved.

Felix: Amazing, thank you. Also have a small Philips floor lamp I can throw in if someone wants it — free pickup with desk.

Mika: Lamp sounds great if Zara doesn't want it.

(Reaction: Zara reacted with :white_check_mark: to Felix's first message)
